  });
  // Close mobile menu when a link is clicked
  mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function () {
      mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      hamburger.innerHTML = '<svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/></svg>';
    });
  });

  /* ── Donation Modal ───────────────────────────────── */
  const modal = document.getElementById('donate-modal');
  const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById('modal-backdrop');
  const modalCloseBtn = document.getElementById('modal-close-btn');
  const donateButtons = [
    document.getElementById('hero-donate-btn'),
    document.getElementById('header-donate-btn'),
    document.getElementById('mobile-donate-btn'),
    document.getElementById('cta-donate-btn'),
  ];

  function openModal() {
    modal.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    modalCloseBtn.focus();
  }
  function closeModal() {
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  donateButtons.forEach(function (btn) {
    if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); openModal(); });
  });
  modalCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  modalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
  });

  // Modal amount selection
  var selectedModalAmount = 50;
  var modalAmounts = modal.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount');
  var modalCustomField = document.getElementById('modal-custom-field');
  var modalCustomInput = document.getElementById('modal-custom-input');
  var modalConfirmBtn = document.getElementById('modal-donate-confirm');

  function updateModalBtn() {
    if (selectedModalAmount === 'custom') {
      var customVal = modalCustomInput.value ? '$' + parseInt(modalCustomInput.value) : 'Custom';
      modalConfirmBtn.textContent = 'Donate ' + customVal + ' →';
    } else {
      modalConfirmBtn.textContent = 'Donate $' + selectedModalAmount + ' →';
    }
  }

  modalAmounts.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      modalAmounts.forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.remove('selected');
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      });
      btn.classList.add('selected');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      selectedModalAmount = btn.dataset.amount;
      if (selectedModalAmount === 'custom') {
        modalCustomField.style.display = 'flex';
        modalCustomInput.focus();
      } else {
        modalCustomField.style.display = 'none';
      }
      updateModalBtn();
    });
  });

  modalCustomInput.addEventListener('input', updateModalBtn);

  // Modal frequency
  var freqBtns = modal.querySelectorAll('.freq-btn');
  freqBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      freqBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
      btn.classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  modalConfirmBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var amt = selectedModalAmount === 'custom'
      ? (modalCustomInput.value ? '$' + parseInt(modalCustomInput.value) : 'an amount')
      : '$' + selectedModalAmount;
    alert('Thank you for your donation of ' + amt + '! In a real site, this would proceed to a secure payment processor.');
    closeModal();
  });

  /* ── Program Accordion ────────────────────────────── */
  var accordionBtns = document.querySelectorAll('#programs-accordion .accordion-btn');
  accordionBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var bodyId = btn.getAttribute('aria-controls');
      var body = document.getElementById(bodyId);
      var isOpen = body.classList.contains('open');

      // close all
      accordionBtns.forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.remove('active');
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        var bBody = document.getElementById(b.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
        bBody.classList.remove('open');
      });

      // open clicked (if it wasn't open)
      if (!isOpen) {
        btn.classList.add('active');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        body.classList.add('open');
      }
    });
  });
  // Open first on load
  accordionBtns[0].classList.add('active');

  /* ── News Carousel ────────────────────────────────── */
  var track = document.getElementById('carousel-track');
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-prev');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('carousel-next');
  var dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
  var currentSlide = 0;

  function getSlideWidth() {
    var card = track.querySelector('.news-card');
    if (!card) return 0;
    var style = window.getComputedStyle(track);
    var gap = parseInt(style.gap || '24', 10);
    return card.offsetWidth + gap;
  }

  function getSlidesPerView() {
    return window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
  }

  function getTotalSlides() {
    var cards = track.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    return Math.max(0, cards - getSlidesPerView() + 1);
  }

  function goToSlide(index) {
    var total = getTotalSlides();
    currentSlide = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, total - 1));
    var offset = currentSlide * getSlideWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';

    // Update dots (only 2 dots: positions 0 and 1+ )
    dots.forEach(function (dot, i) {
      var isActive = (i === 0 && currentSlide === 0) || (i === 1 && currentSlide > 0);
      dot.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
      dot.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    prevBtn.disabled = currentSlide === 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentSlide >= total - 1;
    prevBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide === 0 ? '0.4' : '1';
    nextBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? '0.4' : '1';
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { goToSlide(currentSlide - 1); });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { goToSlide(currentSlide + 1); });
  dots.forEach(function (dot, i) {
    dot.addEventListener('click', function () { goToSlide(i === 0 ? 0 : 1); });
  });

  goToSlide(0);
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { goToSlide(currentSlide); });

  /* ── CTA section amount buttons ──────────────────── */
  var ctaAmounts = document.querySelectorAll('#donate-cta .amount-btn');
  ctaAmounts.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      ctaAmounts.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
      btn.classList.add('selected');
    });
  });

  /* ── Animated Counters ────────────────────────────── */
  function animateCounter(el, target, suffix) {
    var duration = 2000;
    var steps = 60;
    var step = target / steps;
    var current = 0;
    var interval = setInterval(function () {
      current = Math.min(current + step, target);
      el.textContent = Math.round(current);
      if (current >= target) clearInterval(interval);
    }, duration / steps);
  }

  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.count[data-target]');
  var statsSection = document.getElementById('impact');
  var animated = false;

  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    if (entries[0].isIntersecting && !animated) {
      animated = true;
      counters.forEach(function (el) {
        animateCounter(el, parseInt(el.dataset.target, 10));
      });
    }
  }, { threshold: 0.3 });

  if (statsSection) observer.observe(statsSection);

  /* ── Sticky header shadow on scroll ──────────────── */
  var header = document.getElementById('site-header');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    header.style.boxShadow = window.scrollY > 10
      ? '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.12)'
      : '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)';
  });

}());
</script>
